notes: The quoted text is only the closing chapter colophon of chapter 13 of the Devīmāhātmya (Mārkaṇḍeyapurāṇa). It names no scribe, date or place. The catalogue gives the scribe as Jaugīndrapati (perhaps a corrupt form of Yogīndrapati) and the date as VS 1963 (≈1906 CE). Neither appears in the quoted excerpt, so neither was extracted.
